shorts.title: What you will learn: Formatting output
shorts.hook: Make your output look like a real bill.
shorts.script: Make your output look like a real bill. Today we make output tidy. Prices get two decimals, and columns line up like a real bill. Raw output can look messy. Fixed and setprecision give a set number of decimals. Setw sets the width of the next item, so columns line up. These tools live in the iomanip header. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: What you will learn: Formatting output.

shorts.title: Formatting output in one minute
shorts.script: Raw output can look messy. Fixed and setprecision give a set number of decimals. Setw sets the width of the next item, so columns line up. These tools live in the iomanip header. Since C plus plus twenty, std format builds a line from a pattern. Think of a restaurant bill, where all the prices line up on the right. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Formatting output in one minute.

shorts.title: Inside the second program
shorts.hook: The format header gives us std format.
shorts.script: The format header gives us std format. The pattern has two holes, written as curly braces. The first hole takes the name. The second hole takes the price. The code colon dot two f means two decimals. Cout prints the finished line. The program prints, Fish costs one hundred twenty point five zero rupees. Fixed and setprecision control the decimals. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Inside the second program.

shorts.title: Bug of the Day: Precision without fixed
shorts.script: Bug of the Day. We want one hundred twenty point five zero. The program prints a strange short form, one point two e plus zero two. Without fixed, setprecision counts all the digits. Add fixed before setprecision, and you get two decimals. Without fixed, setprecision counts all digits, not only the decimals. Two digits is not enough for one hundred twenty, so cout uses a short scientific form. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.onScreen: BUG OF THE DAY: PRECISION WITHOUT FIXED
shorts.caption: Bug of the Day: Precision without fixed.
